obligations.statement: The product must be capable of being mounted on a wall.
derivation_premises: A product that is wall-mounted requires some interface to a wall.

obligations.statement: The product must have a storage volume capable of holding approximately twenty items.
derivation_premises: To hold items there must be a physical volume.

obligations.statement: The product must release exactly one item per lever press.
derivation_premises: The lever press triggers a mechanism that dispenses a single item.

obligations.statement: The product must allow refilling from the top without detaching from the wall.
derivation_premises: Refilling requires an accessible opening that does not require moving the whole product.

obligations.statement: The product must not jam when nearly empty.
derivation_premises: Item dispensing relies on unobstructed movement of items within the storage.

obligations.statement: The product must provide a lever that the user can reach and press.
derivation_premises: The user must be able to interact with the lever physically.

obligations.statement: The product must have a top opening that the user can reach for refilling.
derivation_premises: User access requires a reachable opening.

obligations.statement: The product must react the weight of the stored items and its own weight to the wall.
derivation_premises: An unsupported load will accelerate; the wall provides support.

obligations.statement: The product must react the force applied by the user on the lever to the wall or other structure.
derivation_premises: The lever must be actuated by a user-applied force.

obligations.statement: The product must provide a mechanism that can count or separate one item from a bulk quantity.
derivation_premises: Dispensing relies on isolating a single item from many.
